select * into d360.dep_casamaster_20250903 from EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER
select * into d360.om_task_run_20250903 from om.om_task_run 

DELETE from om.om_task_run where task_name like '%DEP_CASAMASTER%' 
SELECT FILENAME FROM D360.MANIFEST_FILE WHERE H = 'D' AND SUBSTRING(FILENAME,1,9) = 'CBC01_DEP' 

SELECT * FROM D360.MANIFEST_FILE WHERE SUBSTRING(FILENAME,1,9) = 'CBC01_DEP' AND TABLENAME in ('DEP_CASAMASTER')

SELECT FILENAME,REPLACE(REPLACE(FILENAME,RIGHT(FILENAME,21),''),LEFT(FILENAME,6),'')  FROM D360.MANIFEST_FILE WHERE H = 'D' AND SUBSTRING(FILENAME,1,9) = 'CBC01_DEP' AND TABLENAME in ('DEP_CASAMASTER') AND  REPLACE(REPLACE(FILENAME,RIGHT(FILENAME,21),''),LEFT(FILENAME,6),'') in ('DEP_CASAMASTER')
INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]
(DEPENDENCY_ID, TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))+ (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID),0) FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]) , 'TSK_STG_EDS_CBC01_DEP_CASAMASTER' TASK_NAME,'TSK_EDS_CBC01_DEP_CASAMASTER' DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME


select * from om.om_task_dependency where dependent_task_name like '%DEP_CASAMASTER%'
